milestone: Bounded backend-owned native FP16 core weight materialization
status: Qualified preparation component; whole inference/vLLM parity objective remains active

implementation.frontend: bn_backend_layout_native_f16_init reads native FP8/scale block rows through immutable safetensors index and the registered numeric decoder. One raw/scale tile allocation, no whole host decoded matrix.
implementation.backend: Synchronous buffer_create_f16_rows reads ascending 32-row chunks and packs native [N,K] FP16 bits into immutable CUDA [K,N] storage using bounded host/device tiles. Final stream completion precedes publication and scratch release.
implementation.ownership: GPU handles and packed data live in backend layout resources; source index borrowed only during init. Model-owned backend container frees layouts after consumers complete. Dedicated handles bypass inactive weight pool and ordinary host matvec/matmul reject them.
implementation.budget: Device bound covers final native weight payload plus one device transfer tile. Host bound covers explicit raw/scale/F16 tiles. Other backend/context/allocator/driver allocations are separate.
implementation.errors: Metadata/format/geometry/budget preflight rejects before GPU creation; reader/device failure drains queued packing and frees unpublished allocations. Output layout unchanged on failure.
implementation.diagnostic: CUDA-only readback of completed native [K,N] handles; not called by inference.

validation.original_reference: Frozen unchanged upstream FP8-to-FP16 outputs from the prior stage, compared after transpose/packing.
validation.gpu_synthetic: Partial shapes and all 65536 FP16 bit patterns, budget rejection, wrong owner/capacity, ordinary matvec/matmul rejection, three mid-reader abort/retry cycles; 68906 directly checked words.
validation.cpu_synthetic: Exact budget boundaries, raw/scale decoding, 1x1/35x67 partial grids, source independence, late NaN rollback and failed allocation callback.

limitations: No native dense GEMM/forward operator added yet; full numeric execution config, HC4, router, compressed attention, Engram and generation remain unfinished.
Payload bound is not total VRAM: trace also records 100795392 bytes of pre-constructor backend heap payload, plus separate static/driver/library allocations.
Host bound excludes model/index metadata, CUDA internal pageable-copy staging, allocator overhead and test reference/readback arrays. No total RSS claim.
No cold-storage/throughput or vLLM parity claim.
CUDA is implemented; Metal/NEON/WASM materialization is not qualified here.

documentation_clarification.change: Comment now specifies exact 32-row chunks except final, matching constructor and block-source reader.
